opengwasr: Client for OpenGWAS Data

Source: R/opengwasr-package.R
opengwasr-package.Rd

Query OpenGWAS Analyses, Associations, top hits and linkage disequilibrium (LD), either through the OpenGWAS API or from Store Releases downloaded to a local machine.

Details

opengwasr reads OpenGWAS data through a Source. The API Source queries the OpenGWAS API; a Local Source, planned for a later release, will read Store Releases and LD Stores downloaded to your own machine. Query functions take the Source as their first argument, so the same call works against either.

The terms used throughout the package (Analysis, Association, Source, Store Release and others) are defined in the glossary.
